meta.measures: current src/mnemosyne against the INTENTIONALLY-LIMITED v1 bar

checks.name: model_accepts_image_audio_modalities
checks.bar: v1 bar: Evidence/IngestRequest model image+audio as first-class enum values.
checks.note: Evidence/IngestRequest modality enum = ['audio', 'binary', 'image', 'multimodal', 'text', 'video']

checks.name: single_extraction_interface_modality_agnostic
checks.bar: v1 bar: one MediaTextExtractor Protocol; modality is a parameter, not a fork.
checks.note: MediaTextExtractor.extract(payload, *, media_type, modality, metadata)

checks.name: metadata_extractor_image_audio_identical
checks.bar: v1 bar: default extractor handles image(OCR/caption)+audio(transcript) via one call.
checks.note: image(ocr/caption) + audio(transcript) -> same MediaExtractionResult

checks.name: command_extractor_modality_agnostic_boundary
checks.bar: v1 bar: the real-model extension point is one shell-free command boundary.
checks.note: CommandMediaTextExtractor: one shell-free boundary for any modality

checks.name: embedding_boundary_single_protocol
checks.bar: v1 bar: MediaEmbeddingProvider is one boundary taking modality as a param.
checks.note: MediaEmbeddingProvider.embed_media(payload, *, media_type, modality, metadata)

checks.name: substrate_extends_via_media_extract_job
checks.bar: v1 bar (N5 keystone): image ingest WITHOUT caller text enqueues+runs media_extract onto the SAME ledger.
checks.note: image ingest -> evidence(modality=image) -> media_extract job -> derived text evidence(modality=text) on the SAME ledger (2 jobs run)

checks.name: substrate_indexes_caller_derived_text_inline
checks.bar: v1 bar: audio + caller transcript is indexed inline on the text substrate (no redundant job).
checks.note: audio + caller transcript -> indexed inline on the text substrate (no redundant job)

deferred_real_deployment_validation: Real OCR/ASR/vision model: ship a CommandMediaTextExtractor wrapping a real image-caption / OCR / speech-to-text binary and measure derived-text quality (WER/CER, caption faithfulness) on a labelled image+audio corpus. v1 ships only MetadataMediaTextExtractor (indexes caller-provided derived text) + the command boundary — no model is bundled.

Perceptual media embeddings: wire a real CLIP/CLAP-style MediaEmbeddingProvider and prove cross-modal recall@k on a multimodal retrieval suite. v1 only proves the boundary is honoured (Protocol + CommandMediaEmbeddingProvider), not retrieval lift.
Cross-modal answer quality: extend eval/harness suites with image/audio QA cases and judge end-to-end answers, vs. v1 which only proves the modality plumbing.

Large-binary externalization SLOs: object-store throughput / residency for GB-scale media payloads under load (the substrate externalizes raw bytes today, but the SLOs are unmeasured for media at scale).

checks.bar: v1 bar: parametric_propose is operator-only (reader/agent/consolidator refused).
checks.note: reader/agent/consolidator all refused; parametric_propose is operator-only

checks.name: propose_requires_operator_trust_tier
checks.bar: v1 bar: operator role still needs operator-tier SOURCE trust.
checks.note: operator role + sub-operator source trust correctly refused

checks.name: operator_can_propose_shadow_artifact

checks.note: operator proposes isolated SHADOW local-shadow-adapter (no GPU)

checks.name: rail_bounds_match_blueprint

checks.note: rail bounds = blueprint (superseding 0.05 / prune 0.02 / external_only / monotonic / sink-forbidden)

checks.note: all 9 rail-widening attempts structurally refused: monotonic_trust(disabled), mutation-rate(prune), mutation-rate(source_mutation), mutation-rate(supersession), reward(self_generated), sink(system_prompt), sink(untrusted_flag), teach-to-the-test(eval_overlap), trust_tier(widened)

checks.note: at-limit metrics + external_only reward allowed (rails are bounds, not zero-tolerance)

checks.name: rollback_is_reversible_with_evidence

checks.note: promoted -> rolled_back with ref=rollback-311a87d9-... + protected-suite evidence

checks.name: trainer_boundary_is_injected_subprocess_no_gpu
checks.bar: v1 bar: real trainer is an injected shell-free subprocess seam (exercised, no GPU).
checks.note: CommandParametricTrainer subprocess seam exercised (no GPU); proposal stays shadow

checks.name: default_tier_is_shadow_only_without_trainer
checks.bar: v1 bar: default tier is shadow-only with no trainer/GPU and carries rail labels.
checks.note: default ParametricTier() = shadow-only, no trainer/GPU, carries immutable rail labels

checks.name: artifact_store_is_path_isolated
checks.bar: v1 bar: adapter artifact store is path-fenced (isolated).
checks.note: ParametricArtifactStore rejects path-escape segments (isolated adapter store)

deferred_real_deployment_validation: Real LoRA/test-time-training run: implement a ParametricTrainer (e.g. wrap a PEFT/LoRA fine-tune as a CommandParametricTrainer subprocess) and prove a validated-lesson adapter actually changes served behaviour. v1 ships only the boundary + a local shadow adapter; no weights are trained and no GPU is required.

Catastrophic-forgetting bound: measure the protected-regression suite on the SERVED adapter over many promotion cycles (the §23.6 anti-forgetting claim). v1 only proves the gate refuses promotion on protected regressions in-process.

Base-model isolation at serve time: prove the adapter never mutates base weights or the invariant in a real inference stack. v1 proves isolation structurally (separate artifact store + immutable rail labels), not at a live serving layer.
GPU/throughput SLOs + distillation cadence: training cost, periodic-distillation scheduling, and adapter-store scale are unmeasured in v1.

Operator credential separation as a SEPARATE service/credentials (§23.5): v1 enforces operator authority in-process via SecurityPolicy; production must split the rail-enforcing surface into its own credentialed service.
